column1: # Metadata facts measured from real GGUF files.
# Method: parse each file's header and KV block with an independent
# Python reader and record what it found. The test replays these
# expectations against mlmf-gguf without reading any model file, so
# it passes on a machine that has never downloaded one.
# column is the path RELATIVE to that root, because the corpus is not
# flat: a bare basename cannot be reopened.
# 29 .gguf files were scanned and 28 rows are here. The missing one is
# counts, a different layout below the magic. This build refuses v1 by
# version rather than misparsing it, so there is nothing to measure.
